question: What is the total approximate latitudinal extent of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is 30°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The total approximate **latitudinal extent** of India is **30°**, ranging from **8°4'N to 37°6'N.**
 
• This latitudinal span contributes significantly to the **diverse climatic zones** found across India, including tropical, subtropical, and temperate regions.
 
• The **southernmost point** of India is **Indira Point**, located at 6°45'N in the Nicobar Islands.
 
• The northernmost point of India lies in the **Union Territory of Ladakh** and is near **37°6'N.**
 
• The latitudinal extent plays a crucial role in determining the **duration of daylight hours** across various regions of the country.
 
• This span also influences the distribution of **natural vegetation**, **agriculture**, and even **monsoonal patterns.**
 
• It is important for geographical studies and helps understand India's position in the global context.
